text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model route `embed-quant2` -> version v2.3-quant2 in eu-west1. Canary traffic: 25% (4 hosts). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/smoke-probes. :rocket:
Maya: noticing p95 increase on the embed synthetic probe since ~5m after canary started. p50 fine, p95 jumped from 120ms -> ~460ms for short prompts. :eyes:
Jorge (oncall): I see the same in our synthetic dashboard, plus ~3% 504s from the probe agent for eu-west1. Logs show increased KV cache misses.
Maya: dump from the synth probe: ```json
{"probe":"embed_short","latency_p50":115,"latency_p95":462,"errors":3,"time":"2026-03-22T09:12:02Z"}```
Lucy: can we hold the rollout? if this is correlated to the quantization variant we should pin to previous stable model in region.
Kevin: Agreed — small canary but we should avoid wider blast. Suggest pinning the eu-west1 route to v2.2-stable and draining canary hosts.
deploy-bot: Canary auto-threshold check failed: p95 > threshold (300ms). Initiating paused state. Canary traffic frozen at 25%. :rotating_light:
Jorge (oncall): I'll collect traces and a couple of coredumps if any. Can someone run a quick curl against the probe endpoint to capture headers? e.g.:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"test"}' --connect-timeout 5 -w '\nHTTP_CODE:%{http_code} TOTAL_TIME:%{time_total}'
```
Maya: ran that, got: `HTTP_CODE:200 TOTAL_TIME:0.43` on one host, but others: `HTTP_CODE:504 TOTAL_TIME:6.01` — suggests some hosts are timing out and others ok.
Lucy: I'll pin route now. Command to pin via control plane: ```bash
redwoodctl routes set embed-route --region eu-west1 --model v2.2-stable --reason "post-canary p95 spike"
```
Maya: executing pin now.
Maya: done — route pinned to v2.2-stable in eu-west1. Confirmed by console. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Route update recorded. Canary hosts removed from serving pool for embed-quant2 in eu-west1. Event: route.pin.user (Maya).
Kevin: fine follow-up steps: 1) Roll back canary to 0% (drain) 2) Collect perf traces for affected hosts (Jorge) 3) Run a targeted reproducer against quant2 on one host with debug logging (Maya) 4) Postmortem/triage entry if root cause is quantization regression (Lucy).
Jorge (oncall): gathering traces now, sending links when uploaded to the trace bucket. Quick look at kernel stats shows small spike in pagefaults on two hosts around the incident window — could be memory layout / quant kernel OOM path.
Maya: repro run against the failing host with `--debug-kv` enabled shows higher KV eviction rate; suspecting different memory footprint for quantized weights causing more cache pressure.
Lucy: For the short-term: keep pin in eu-west1, update release notes to mark v2.3-quant2 as paused for EU rollout. For long-term: we need a perf test that includes embed synthetic probes across a range of token lengths and kv-cache sizes.
Maya: I'll open the follow-up ticket and attach traces + repro steps. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/ops/INC-5542
Kevin: Thanks. If SRE confirms no host-level instability, we can resume a narrower canary after a fix with extra observability flags.
Jorge (oncall): Uploaded traces: gs://redwood-traces/1789999998/ — trace IDs: trace-ff1a, trace-ff1b. Added initial notes to the ticket.
Maya: quick status: route pinned, canary drained, ticket created, traces uploaded. Will follow up in the ticket thread.
Lucy: Adding a short blurb to release notes and notifying customers in eu region who are on early access.
deploy-bot: Incident note auto-created from route pin event: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1789999998. Use runbook "post-deploy-synth-falldown" for recovery checklist.
Kevin: Nice coordination — keeping the pin until eng-runtime/eng-ml validate quant kernels. Marking this thread resolved for rollout decision.
Maya: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring synth dashboards and ping if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
